name: v6b
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent does the message express? Pick the single most specific intent; the examples under an intent are real messages labelled with it.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a (new) card, or problems activating it.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum/maximum age to open or use an account; can children or teenagers have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or Android Pay with the card, including topping up via them or them not working.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs/cash machines the card works with, where to find an ATM, or doing things at ATMs (e.g. which ATMs let me change my PIN).

automatic_top_up.meaning: Anything about automatic/auto top-up: setting it up, where it is, how it works, its limits, adding money automatically.
examples: What, if any, is the limit  for auto top-up?

balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.meaning: Money coming INTO the customer's account by bank transfer (e.g. a transfer from their UK account, a 'balance transfer') has not updated the balance / is not showing yet.
examples: Why is it taking so long to update my balance transfer?
What's the time frame normally for a UK account transfer? I just made one and it's not showing up anywhere. I want to be sure that everything is good.

balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash.meaning: Money the customer deposited (cheque, cash, or just 'deposited money') is not showing in the balance yet; when will my deposit show up.
examples: I recently deposited some money into my account, but it still isn't showing up. What's going on?

beneficiary_not_allowed.meaning: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee or a transfer to a beneficiary is not allowed/rejected because of the beneficiary.
examples: I am having trouble transferring money to a beneficiery.

criteria.cancel_transfer: Wanting to cancel, stop, undo or reverse a transfer/transaction the customer made (e.g. sent to wrong account, want to take back a transaction).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; how to get a replacement/renewed card because of expiry; what happens when it expires.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted / can be used (merchants, shops, online); limits on where it's accepted.
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet; still waiting for my card; tracking the card delivery.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, when to expect a card, express/fast-tracked delivery. (Where cards can be delivered is order_physical_card.)

card_linking.meaning: Linking a card to the account/app (e.g. linking a found card or an existing card, adding a card in the app).
examples: If my card was lost or stolen can I re-link it?

card_not_working.meaning: The card is not working / never goes through / not functioning, tried multiple times or at multiple places (not specifically contactless, ATM, or virtual card).
examples: What's going on with my card? I've tried multiple times and it never goes through.

card_payment_fee_charged.meaning: A fee was charged on a card payment/purchase; extra amount charged for paying by card.
examples: Let me know when you charge extra for payments please. I just checked the app earlier when I saw that there was an additional fee on one of the payments that I wasn't warned about before.

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: An unknown/unrecognised card payment or purchase on the account that the customer didn't make.

card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate.meaning: A card payment (purchase abroad/in foreign currency) got the wrong or a bad exchange rate.
examples: It seems that the rate I got is incorrect.
I exchanged Russian rubles for British pounds today and got less than I expected. Was exchange rate correct?

criteria.card_swallowed: ATM/cash machine kept, ate or swallowed the card; card stuck in the machine.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for cash/ATM withdrawals; why was I charged for withdrawing cash.

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.meaning: An unknown/unrecognised cash or ATM withdrawal on the account; the app shows a cash withdrawal or cash amount the customer did not make or did not receive.
examples: My app is showing a cash balance that I did not receive.

change_pin.meaning: How to change or reset the PIN, including whether and at which ATMs/cash machines it can be changed; set up a new PIN. Getting the PIN for a new card belongs to get_physical_card.
examples: Can I change my pin at a cash machine?

criteria.compromised_card: Card details may be compromised or stolen while the customer still has the card; someone else may be using my card or card info; fraud suspicion.

country_support.meaning: Which countries the bank/card/account is available or supported in; can I use the service if I live in or move to country X.
examples: Can I get support?
In which countries can I get a card?

criteria.declined_card_payment: A specific card payment/purchase was declined or rejected (when the customer does not call it a transfer and does not say the card generally doesn't work).
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM/cash withdrawal was declined or refused; couldn't get money out of the ATM.

declined_transfer.meaning: Transfers being declined or rejected. Use this whenever the customer says their 'transfer' was declined, even if they were trying to buy something.
examples: Why do you keep declining my transfers? it's always been working really well so far but when I tried to buy something just now the card got declined, I tried couple of times already  but same thing is happening.

criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: An unknown/unrecognised direct debit on the account.

disposable_card_limits.meaning: Limits/restrictions of disposable virtual cards: how many disposable cards I can make (e.g. per day), how many times one can be used.
examples: I must make several disposable cards every day.

criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal or account details: name, address, phone number, email.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or charges for exchanging currency; what is the exchange fee.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used, current rates, how exchange rates are determined (general, not a complaint about a specific transaction's wrong rate).
criteria.exchange_via_app: Exchanging/converting currencies in the app; can I exchange currency X to Y; how to do currency exchange.

extra_charge_on_statement.meaning: An unexplained extra charge or small fee on the statement/account (e.g. 'why was I charged an extra £1', 'charged a dollar that shows as pending'), not clearly tied to a specific kind of transaction.
examples: Why is it showing that my account has been charged a dollar that is showing as pending?

failed_transfer.meaning: A transfer failed or didn't go through / did not process.
examples: Hi, I'm in progress of purchasing a flat and am trying to make to make a payment.  An error is appearing, and I need assistance.
Why do my transfers keep failing?

criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which (fiat) currencies are supported for holding, exchanging or spending; can I hold/use currency X.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable virtual card.

get_physical_card.meaning: Getting the PIN for a card: how do I get a PIN for my card, where to find the PIN for my new card. (Asking where/how to get a physical card is order_physical_card.)
examples: how do i get a pin for my card

getting_spare_card.meaning: Getting an additional/spare/extra/another card alongside the current one, e.g. ordering another card, a second card, or a card for a family member.
examples: How do I go about ordering another card?

getting_virtual_card.meaning: How to get or order a (non-disposable) virtual card, its cost.
examples: I ordered a virtual card but it hasn't come through yet

lost_or_stolen_card.meaning: Card was lost or stolen (the customer no longer has it); found a lost card.
examples: Can you help me retrieve my card?

criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone was lost or stolen or left behind; accessing the account without the phone.

order_physical_card.meaning: Ordering or getting a (new/another) physical card: where/how can I get a physical card, a card I can hold, cost of a card, where cards can be delivered, choosing delivery when ordering.
examples: Where can I get a physical card?
Where can the cards be delivered?

criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/password; reset passcode; can't log in to the app.

pending_card_payment.meaning: A card payment/purchase is pending, or a 'payment' (not described as a transfer) hasn't gone through yet / is still processing. A small unexplained charge showing as pending is extra_charge_on_statement.
examples: I was wondering why my payment hasn't gone through yet, its been a while.

criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is pending or has not come out of the account yet.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending, taking long, not yet completed.

pending_transfer.meaning: The customer's transfer or outgoing transaction is shown as pending / outgoing / not cleared; why is my transfer still pending.
examples: I have an outgoing transaction
How long do you expect me to wait for the transfer? It finally worked out, but has been pending for a long time and it's quite urgent.

criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts; unblock PIN.

receiving_money.meaning: How to receive money into the account (from friends, salary, from abroad).
examples: Can I use a transfer to receive my transfer?

criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: An expected refund from a merchant has not appeared on the account.
criteria.request_refund: Wanting to get a refund / return policy / how to request a refund for a purchase.

reverted_card_payment?.meaning: A card payment was reverted, cancelled, returned, or the money was deducted for a purchase and then came back / the seller says the payment didn't go through.
examples: Seems like my card payment has been cancelled

supported_cards_and_currencies.meaning: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, cards issued in which countries) and currencies can be used to add money / top up, including problems adding money from an unsupported card such as American Express.
examples: Why doesn't it work when I use American Express to try to add money to my account?
How can I get funds into my account from my American Express?

criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees/charges for topping up by bank transfer.

top_up_by_card_charge.meaning: Fees/charges for topping up with a card.
examples: Do you charge a fee for adding money in USD?

top_up_by_cash_or_cheque.meaning: Topping up / adding money with cash or a cheque, or other non-card ways to top up such as topping up online.
examples: Can I top up online?

top_up_failed.meaning: A top-up failed, was declined, isn't working, or the customer is unsure whether a top-up went through ('pop-up' is a common typo for top-up).
examples: I can't access my money. Is it because somethings wrong with the top-up? I set it up correctly.
I'm not sure if my pop-up went through.

criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on (manual) top-ups: maximum/minimum amount, how much or how often I can top up. Auto top-up questions belong to automatic_top_up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up is explicitly described as reverted, cancelled or returned, or the top-up first showed up / went through in the account and later disappeared.

topping_up_by_card.meaning: How to top up with a card; tried to top up with a card and the money disappeared or something went wrong (unless it is explicitly reverted, pending or failed, or the top-up first appeared and then vanished).
examples: The money disappeared when I tried to use my card to top up.

criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Charged twice / duplicate payment for the same transaction.

transfer_fee_charged.meaning: A fee was charged on a transfer, or a higher fee for doing banking/sending money abroad; why was I charged for a transfer.
examples: Could you inform me as to why I have been charged a higher fee for doing banking abroad.
I have used this account overseas recently. Has there been an increase in fees that I am unaware of?

transfer_into_account.meaning: How to transfer/add money into my account by bank transfer; problems transferring money into my own account.
examples: My money is all gone. What ways are okay to add money to my account?

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.meaning: A transfer or transaction the customer sent out (to a friend, person, retailer, account, within the country) is 'not here yet' / still not showing up for the recipient / hasn't gone through or is taking too long to complete, even after days and double-checking details.
examples: i've waited 2 days for a transfer to reach a retailers account, am i going to have to wait longer.
How long does it take for money to transfer?  I sent some to a friend and it hasn't gone through yet.
I transferred some money but it is not here yet

I made a transfer the day before yesterday within this country. It is still not showing up at all. I have double-checked and the account number is certainly right. I've actually type this multiple times. can you look into what is going on here?
Why is my transaction taking so long to complete?

criteria.transfer_timing: General question about how long transfers take to arrive or be processed (not a specific sent transfer that the recipient still hasn't received).
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Trying to verify identity but it failed or isn't working.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; the identity verification process, documents needed.

verify_source_of_funds.meaning: Verifying, proving or seeing the source of funds/money (where my money comes from, seeing my available money); questions about checks and security around the customer's money. Verifying a top-up card is verify_top_up.
examples: What kind of security protects my money?
my money, where is it coming from?
Can I see my available money?

criteria.verify_top_up: Verification for a top-up: verifying the card used for a top-up, the top-up verification code, 3D secure for a top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card is not working / payment with virtual card fails.

visa_or_mastercard.meaning: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing between them; wanting to get a Visa (or Mastercard) card specifically.
examples: I'm wanting to get a Visa card today.

criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is needed; can I use the account without verifying.

wrong_amount_of_cash_received.meaning: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / less money than requested.
examples: The ATM didn't give me what I asked for but my balance says it did

criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: The exchange rate applied to cash taken out (ATM withdrawal abroad, 'amount of cash', getting cash) was wrong or too high.
